visual_findings: Original hall layout, original Brax, face, clothing branding and green accents preserved.
Bag straps, welded chain links, leather seams and ring finishing visibly refined.
34 original materials upgraded; original source-linked brick normal and six linear roughness maps applied.
Brax final normal strength 0.60, roughness floor 0.78, metallic scale 0; original atlas highlights retained.
No new missing surfaces, detached fittings or obvious geometry regression in the reviewed stills.
The wide hall is moderately refined; this review does not claim a radical or photorealistic transformation.

Representative wall, ring apron, squat rack and ground collision checks, not every mesh or animation.
Still screenshots support visual review; tracked runtime bone motion and bag response support action validation.
